mapper.select: SELECT bd_mgt_sn, use_apr_day, strct_cd_nm, viol_bd_yn, ugrnd_flr, road_side_code_nm, hjd_cd, ST_Latitude(center) AS lat, ST_Longitude(center) AS lng FROM buildings WHERE bd_mgt_sn > #{lastId} ORDER BY bd_mgt_sn LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ST_Latitude(geom) AS lat, ST_Longitude(geom) AS lng FROM fire_station
SELECT hjd_cd, AVG(cnt) AS avgCnt FROM fire WHERE year BETWEEN #{fromYear} AND #{toYear} GROUP BY hjd_cd
SELECT m.bd_mgt_sn, s.sago_date, ST_Distance_Sphere(b.center, s.geom) AS distanceM FROM building_sinkhole_map m JOIN sinkhole s ON s.sago_no = m.sago_no JOIN buildings b ON b.bd_mgt_sn = m.bd_mgt_sn
SELECT m.bd_mgt_sn, f.year AS year, MAX(f.grade) AS grade FROM building_flood_map m JOIN flood f ON f.sn = m.sn GROUP BY m.bd_mgt_sn, f.year
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO safety_score_audit ( bd_mgt_sn, total_score, struct_score, fire_score, sink_score, flood_score, use_apr_day, strct_cd_nm, viol_bd_yn, ugrnd_flr, road_side_code_nm, station_dist_m, dong_fire_avg, dong_fire_quartile, sink_cnt, flood_cnt ) VALUES
(#{row.bdMgtSn}, #{row.totalScore}, #{row.structScore}, #{row.fireScore}, #{row.sinkScore}, #{row.floodScore}, #{row.useAprDay,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{row.strctCdNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.violBdYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{row.ugrndFlr,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{row.roadSideCodeNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{row.stationDistM,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.dongFireAvg,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{row.dongFireQuartile,jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{row.sinkCnt}, #{row.floodCnt})
